name: Southern Cross Health Clinic: free for concession card holders
summary: Student-run allied health clinics at Lismore, Gold Coast and Coffs Harbour, free for concession card holders and $10 otherwise.
key: Concession card holders: no charge. Non-concession card holders: $10. All initial appointments are no charge.
who: Open to students, staff and the community. Fees depend on whether you hold a concession card.
how: Book through the Health Clinic page.
numbers: Exercise physiology, massage, naturopathy, osteopathy, occupational therapy, speech pathology and more, depending on campus
catches: The separate free Mental Health and Wellbeing Clinic is not available to current SCU students or staff.

evidence.quote: All initial appointments are no charge.
